reference_sql:
SELECT p.category_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', '')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sku_off,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category_raw NOT IN (SELECT c.category_name FROM categories AS c) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_category_raw_off
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', ''))
   OR p.category_raw NOT IN (SELECT c.category_name FROM categories AS c)
GROUP BY p.category_id
ORDER BY p.category_id
alternatives:
SELECT p.category_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', '')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sku_off,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.category_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_category_raw_off
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_name = p.category_raw
WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', ''))
   OR c.category_id IS NULL
GROUP BY p.category_id
ORDER BY p.category_id

WITH checks AS (  -- one row per product, with a flag for each text key
  SELECT p.product_id,
         p.category_id,
         CASE WHEN p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', '')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sku_off,
         CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories AS c WHERE c.category_name = p.category_raw) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS raw_off
  FROM products AS p
)
SELECT category_id,
       SUM(sku_off) AS n_sku_off,
       SUM(raw_off) AS n_category_raw_off
FROM checks
GROUP BY category_id
HAVING SUM(sku_off) + SUM(raw_off) > 0
ORDER BY category_id

other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN with IS NULL finds the names no category has, but NOT IN with a subquery reads closer to the rule.

solver.query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT category_id,
         (sku <> upper(sku) OR sku LIKE '% %') AS sku_off,
         (category_raw NOT IN (SELECT category_name FROM categories WHERE category_name IS NOT NULL)) AS cat_off
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sku_off) AS n_sku_off,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cat_off) AS n_category_raw_off
FROM f
WHERE sku_off OR cat_off
GROUP BY category_id
ORDER BY category_id NULLS LAST
